warning.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover SDV8 Timing Chain & Injector Wear
paragraphs: If your Range Rover SDV8 is an L322 or L405 model with the TDV8 or SDV8 engine — which covers the entire production run of this variant — timing chain and injector wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine family, confirmed across Land Rover specialist forums and independent garages. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR, turbo components, and gaskets as standard on every SDV8 rebuild.
Other Range Rover engine variants (such as the 6-cylinder diesels or newer Ingenium units) do not share this specific pattern, but the TDV8/SDV8 engine family has this established wear pattern.
warning.source: Source: extremely well-corroborated across Land Rover specialist forums and independent garages (per G-BRF). Excludes other Range Rover engine variants
